title: Barcode scanners not syncing at Hosur warehouse
description: Handheld scanners lose connection to the ERP every few minutes after the go-live.

title: Month-end stock valuation report times out
description: Stock valuation report takes over two hours at month-end.

title: Temporary increase of class A safety stock during semiconductor shortage
description: Global semiconductor shortage: lead times for class A electronic components have tripled. Request to raise class A safety stock from 15 to 30 days of cover until supply normalises. Review and revert in Q4 2021.
resolution: Class A safety stock changed to 30 days on 07-Apr-2021 by neha. Revert review to be scheduled for Q4 2021. Ticket closed.

title: Cycle count app crashes on older tablets
description: Counting app closes when scanning more than 200 items in one session.
resolution: App update 3.2 fixed the memory issue.

title: Supplier rejected auto-generated purchase orders for MAT-7730
description: Supplier SUP-204 rejected 14 automatically created purchase orders for material MAT-7730 in one week. The supplier says the material is on allocation and only accepts scheduled call-offs. Cancelled orders attract a penalty under the supply contract.
resolution: Orders cancelled manually. Fixed by inventory configuration team.

title: Skip incoming inspection for certified supplier SUP-118
description: SUP-118 has passed the certified supplier programme audit with zero defects for 24 months. Request to skip incoming inspection lots for this supplier; quality will audit them twice a year instead.
resolution: Inspection skip configured for SUP-118 on 20-Feb-2023 by rohit.

title: Inter-plant transfer stuck in transit
description: Transfer from Pune to Hosur shows in transit for 9 days after physical receipt.
resolution: Goods receipt posted at Hosur. Resolved.

title: Inventory Management Policy v2.1 published
description: Policy v2.1 introduces a minimum remaining shelf life of 60 percent for perishable materials at receipt. Please configure the receiving check.
resolution: Shelf-life check configured on 03-Oct-2024 by rohit.

title: Knowledge transfer: Deepa M. retiring 31-Jan-2026
description: Deepa M. (inventory and MRP configuration lead since 2019) retires on 31-Jan-2026. Please arrange handover of configuration knowledge to the new admin.
resolution: One handover session held. No written documentation produced.
